name: Wooden Chest
Contents: 10 gold coins, a rusty dagger, 2 health potions
Description: A weathered oak chest with iron hinges. The wood is stained dark from years of moisture.

name: Iron Chest
Contents: 50 gold coins, a steel shield, fire resistance ring
Description: A reinforced chest of black iron with riveted corners. Scratches mar its surface from past attempts to break it open.

name: Ornate Chest
Contents: 200 gold coins, an enchanted longsword, arcane scroll
Trap: Gas cloud releases on opening (1d6 poison damage)
Description: A gilded chest inlaid with mother-of-pearl. Filigree patterns of dragons coil across its lid.

name: Skeleton Key Chest
Contents: 150 gold coins, lockpicking tools, skeleton key set
Location: Thieves' guild vault, crime lord's hideout
Description: A slim chest of dark mahogany with a lock resembling a grinning skull. It hums faintly when touched.

name: Crystal Chest
Contents: 500 gold coins, prism blade, 3 spell gems
Description: Translucent crystal that glows with shifting colors. The contents are visible but unreachable without opening it.

name: Dragonbone Chest
Contents: 1000 gold coins, dragon scale armor, fire breath amulet
Description: Forged from ancient dragon bones fused with obsidian. Runes glow crimson along its seams, radiating heat.

name: Rusty Treasure Chest
Contents: 5 gold coins, a tarnished ring, stale bread
Description: A corroded iron chest barely holding together. The lock has fused to the frame through decades of rust.

name: Gilded Chest
Contents: 80 gold coins, jeweled bracelet, rare gemstone
Description: A chest plated in gold leaf with emerald accents. It gleams even in dim light.

name: Pirate's Lockbox
Contents: 60 gold coins, pirate map fragment, compass
Description: A barnacle-encrusted iron box with a ship's wheel mechanism on the lid. Saltwater stains mark its surface.

name: Mimic Chest
Contents: 120 gold coins, adhesive slime, mimic tongue (alchemical component)
Description: Appears as a standard wooden chest but breathes subtly. Its "hinge" is a row of small teeth.

name: Leather Bag
Contents: 8 gold coins, dried rations, a whetstone
Description: A worn leather satchel with a brass buckle. The strap is frayed from heavy use.

name: Silk Pouch
Contents: 100 gold coins, invisibility scroll, perfume vial
Description: A delicate pouch of violet silk embroidered with silver thread. It smells of jasmine.

name: Woven Basket
Contents: 3 gold coins, healing herbs, a wooden charm
Description: A tightly woven wicker basket with a handle. Dried herbs hang from its rim.

name: Bandolier Pouch
Contents: 25 gold coins, 3 throwing knives, smoke bomb
Description: A small pouch attached to a worn leather bandolier. Multiple pockets suggest a methodical owner.

name: Enchanted Satchel
Contents: 300 gold coins, bag of holding (minor), teleportation rune
Trap: Dimensional rift (pulls user into pocket dimension for 1 round)
Description: A canvas satchel that seems larger on the inside. Arcane symbols pulse with faint blue light across its surface.

name: Coin Purse
Contents: 15 gold coins, a lucky coin, merchant's receipt
Description: A small velvet purse with a drawstring. The fabric is worn smooth from constant handling.

name: Plague Doctor's Bag
Contents: 20 gold coins, antidote (3 doses), vial of acid
Description: A black leather medical bag marked with a faded caduceus. It reeks of herbs and chemicals.

name: Gem Pouch
Contents: 150 gold coins, 4 uncut gems, jeweler's loupe
Description: A heavy velvet pouch that clinks softly when moved. The fabric is reinforced with thin chain mail.

name: Fallen Warrior
Contents: 30 gold coins, battle-worn sword, chainmail vest
Description: The body of a soldier in dented armor. A fatal wound marks their chest. Their sword arm still grips the hilt.

name: Dead Merchant
Contents: 40 gold coins, trade ledger, ruby signet ring
Description: A portly figure in fine but torn robes. Their merchant's scales are scattered nearby, weighed down by blood.

name: Fallen Paladin
Contents: 75 gold coins, holy avenger blade, divine amulet
Description: A knight in shining plate armor kneeling in prayer. Holy light still emanates faintly from their blade.

name: Skeleton Scout
Contents: 5 gold coins, shortbow, map of local area
Description: A bleached skeleton in leather armor. Arrows protrude from its ribcage. A tattered map is clutched in bony fingers.

name: Ancient Lich
Contents: 500 gold coins, phylactery fragment, lich's grimoire
Trap: Necrotic explosion (3d8 necrotic damage on contact)
Description: A withered corpse in decaying robes. Green火焰 flicker in empty eye sockets. Dark energy writhes around its hands.

name: Dead Adventurer
Contents: 10 gold coins, backpack, rope and pitons
Description: A fresh corpse in travel-worn gear. Their journal describes a trap they failed to avoid. A pickaxe lies nearby.

name: Fallen Mage
Contents: 80 gold coins, spellbook, arcane focus crystal
Trap: None (but the spellbook is cursed - reading it deals 1d4 psychic damage)
Description: A robed figure sprawled amid shattered vials. Arcane sigils glow faintly on their skin. Their spellbook is clutched tight.

name: Mummified King
Contents: 300 gold coins, crown of the ancients, royal scepter
Trap: Curse of the king (disadvantage on all saves for 24 hours)
Description: A desiccated corpse wrapped in golden bandages. A jeweled crown rests atop its head. Hieroglyphs cover the sarcophagus.

name: Secret Stash
Contents: 12 gold coins, a stolen ring, forged documents
Location: Behind loose brick in tavern, hollow tree
Description: A small cavity hidden in the wall. A few coins and contraband are wrapped in oiled cloth.

name: Wall Cache
Contents: 45 gold coins, poison vial, lockpick set
Description: A recess behind a painting of a hunting scene. The wall panel swings open with a click.

name: Hidden Safe
Contents: 180 gold coins, deed to property, blackmail letters
Description: A steel safe concealed beneath floorboards. It's cold to the touch and weighs a considerable amount.

name: Dead Drop
Contents: 20 gold coins, coded message, small key
Description: A hollow compartment in a stone marker. A folded note and key are sealed in wax.

name: Forgotten Altar
Contents: 250 gold coins, blessing amulet, divine spell scroll
Description: A moss-covered stone altar with faded divine symbols. When prayed to, a hidden compartment opens with golden light.

name: Smuggler's Hole
Contents: 35 gold coins, contraband goods, sea chart
Description: A false bottom in a shipping crate. Goods are wrapped in tarred canvas to conceal them.

name: Vampire's Coffin Compartment
Contents: 400 gold coins, vampire blood vial, sunstone
Trap: Vampiric curse (user gains vampiric weakness for 7 days)
Lock: Blood lock (requires vampire blood to open)
Description: A hidden drawer in an ornate coffin. The wood is black ebony inlaid with silver.

name: Ancient Cache
Contents: 100 gold coins, relic fragment, ancient coin collection
Description: A false panel in an exhibit case containing a duplicate artifact. The real cache is behind it.

name: Supply Barrel
Contents: 2 gold coins, dried rations, rope
Description: A standard oak barrel with iron bands. It smells of salted meat and preserved fish.

name: Explosive Barrel
Contents: 15 gold coins, alchemist's fire, gunpowder
Trap: Explosion on heavy impact (2d6 fire damage in 10ft radius)
Description: A barrel marked with hazard symbols. It ticks faintly when disturbed and smells of sulfur.

name: Arcane Orb
Contents: 200 gold coins, spell focus orb, mana crystal
Trap: Arcane backlash (1d8 force damage on failed INT save)
Description: A hovering crystal orb pulsing with inner light. It drifts slightly when no one is looking.

name: Fairy Treasure
Contents: 60 gold coins, fairy dust, wish fragment
Trap: Shrinks user to 6 inches tall for 1 hour
Description: A tiny chest of living wood with flowers growing from it. It chirps and giggles when approached.

name: Necromantic Reliquary
Contents: 600 gold coins, phylactery shard, undead command tablet
Description: A black iron reliquary etched with death runes. It pulses with sickly green energy and whispers to the living.
